candidate.user_submission: Pikin dey 18 months old. E get fever for 2 days, temperature na 38.0°C. E get rash wey cover body. Cornea dey cloud. Eye dey red. No pus dey comot for eye. E no get runny nose. E no dey cough and no dey breathe hard. E no get cough because of measles. E never get measles for the last 3 months. E no get mouth ulcer. No deep or big mouth ulcer. E no dey vomit everything. E fit drink or suck breast. E never get convulsion before, and e no dey convulse now. E no dey weak or lose sense. E no get stiff neck. E no get diarrhoea. E no get ear wahala. Dem check for malaria, the test dey and result na negative. Malaria risk dey high. No obvious reason wey fit cause the fever. Dem never identify any bacterial cause for the fever.
